text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaaawn*... Huh...? 
Is it mornin' already...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies, Lady Big. 
Did I wake you...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Samson Big. My roommate, who confronts 
every 
challenge with undaunted courage—earning 
even 
Narita Brian's respect.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I intended to rise without making a 
sound, of course... 
Yet she is truly not one to be 
underestimated.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is still what one would call early 
morning. 
You may return to your slumber for a while 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
*Mumble mumble*... Really~? 
'Kay then, g'night... *snoooore*...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(......Barely five o'clock. 
Yet my eyes are wide awake.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Perhaps I shall go gaze upon the 
dawn.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How long have I yearned for this 
morning...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...None of that unruly physical distress 
peculiar to my inverse body temperature is 
here.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Hah, hah... hah, hah—*

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(It is not my body, but my heart that 
burns hot. 
I feel as though the welling inferno might 
scorch me through.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I kick off the turf in sheer joy. How 
long has it been 
since I ran simply out of a desire to 
run?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Heh, heh...—Haha.*

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Am I not behaving like a mere child?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot suppress this pre-battle shiver. 
My legs ache to test their mettle without 
delay.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Above all else—at long last. Finally.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I can repay the debt I owe.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I could never allow my Trainer to 
see me 
in such an impatient state.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Well now. Then just one more lap 
to glide along the track.

And so arrived the day of 
Phalaenopsis's debut.
choice_data_list: Were you able to eat this morning?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
Just as usual.
choice_data_list: I see. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Everything is in perfect order.
choice_data_list:
...Mind if I check your legs, just in 
case?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Compose yourself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our debut race. It is our first grand 
stage. 
Thus, I understand why your nerves may get 
the better of you. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Look at me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Do you not believe in me?
choice_data_list: Of course not! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then what cause have you to worry? 
You need only bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: To the arrival of an enduring spring.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, I shall not stumble in a place 
like this. 
Not the me you have trained.
choice_data_list: Right! There's no way you would!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You would do well to start thinking 
of the praise you will bestow upon your 
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *exhale*... 
First, I have reached this point.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How long I have yearned for this day. 
Come, give the signal to begin.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall show them a run poured with my 
heart and soul.
